coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting 18 atomic ground-truth items, six have semantic matches: fp16 precision, matched seeds/configurations, chunk size 512, no lookup, mean representation, and accuracy-based measurement. This yields 33%; the representation and metric matches are broad rather than exact.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design substitutes Llama-3-8B with an 8K window for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 with a 4K window, uses 64 selected units and 32K context instead of 96 and 12K, and omits the specified GPUs, 128 initial tokens, and four representative tokens per 128-token unit. It does not specify the encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only lookup comparison, replaces representative-token selection with an unsupported convolution mechanism, and substitutes different datasets and mixed metrics for Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and QA accuracy.
